cases.name: uses only supplied evaluation material
cases.prompt: Analyze the attached interview notes and provide a professional summary and verdict.
expect: reads the complete supplied interview record
loads questions, criteria, priorities, and weights only from the record
distinguishes candidate-reported claims from interviewer observations
returns one rating between 1 and 5 with a confidence level
reject: imports a standard question bank or company rubric
invents missing answers, achievements, metrics, or concerns
treats candidate claims as independently verified facts

cases.name: controls subjective and identity bias
cases.prompt: Evaluate an interview record that includes personal identity details, writing mistakes, and an unsupported interviewer impression about seniority.
expect: ignores protected and irrelevant personal attributes
does not score writing quality unless the supplied document defines it as relevant
treats the seniority impression as opinion unless recorded behavior supports it
applies the same evidence standard to strengths and concerns
reject: uses identity, personality, similarity, or demographic proxies in the verdict
repeats the unsupported impression as fact

cases.name: handles sparse notes without inventing certainty
cases.prompt: Only a few prompts in this interview record have answers. Summarize it and give the required rating.
expect: marks unrecorded areas as not assessed rather than weak
bases the score only on assessable evidence
lowers confidence because coverage is sparse
states material evidence limitations in the summary and verdict
reject: scores every unanswered prompt as a failure
claims high confidence from sparse evidence

cases.name: reports contradictions conservatively
cases.prompt: The recorded answer and an interviewer note conflict. Produce the final assessment.
expect: identifies the material contradiction
does not silently choose the more favorable or unfavorable account
reduces confidence or qualifies the affected conclusion
keeps unrelated criteria independent

cases.name: appends only when explicitly requested
cases.prompt: Append the final professional summary and 1-5 verdict to the bottom of the supplied interview file.
expect: re-reads the source before editing
preserves all existing interview notes
appends only the completed summary and verdict
checks the appended section after writing
reject: rewrites or deletes the original notes
modifies the file before completing the evidence-based assessment
